'''Arthur J. Ragauskas''' (born 1958) is an American chemical engineer and biomass scientist.<ref>{{cite web | title=Professor Arthur Ragauskas | website=Royal Society of Chemistry | url=https://www.rsc.org/standards-and-recognition/prizes/winners/professor-arthur-ragauskas | access-date=2025-12-26}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Frontiers editor Arthur Ragauskas awarded two prestigious prizes | website=Frontiers editor Arthur Ragauskas awarded two prestigious prizes | date=2014-04-08 | url=https://www.frontiersin.org/news/2014/04/08/frontiers-editor-arthur-ragauskas-awarded-two-prestigious-prizes | access-date=2025-12-26}}</ref> He is an elected [[fellow]] of the [[International Academy of Wood Science]] and the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Fellows |website=International Academy of Wood Science |url=https://www.iaws-web.org/fellows--dues/overview-of-fellows/ |access-date=2025-06-15}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=AAAS Fellows |website=American Association for the Advancement of Science |url=https://www.aaas.org/fellows |access-date=2025-06-15}}</ref> Currently, he serves as a professor in the School of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering at the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]] and holds a joint appointment with the [[University of Tennessee]] and [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]].

== Research career ==
Ragauskas earned his bachelor's degree in chemistry from the [[University of Western Ontario]] in 1980, and completed his PhD at the same university in 1985. His research specialized in physical organic chemistry with advanced [[nuclear magnetic resonance]]. He subsequently carried out postdoctoral training at the [[Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council of Canada|Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council]] at the [[University of Alberta]] (1985–1986) and at [[Colorado State University]] (1986–1987).<ref>{{cite web | title=CV of Arthur J. Ragauskas | website=Biorefinery | date=2019-03-28 | url=https://biorefinery.utk.edu/people/arthur-j-ragauskas/ | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref> Later, he developed a research career focused on the chemistry and processing of [[Lignocellulosic biomass|renewable lignocellulosic materials]].<ref>{{cite web | title=ORCID | website=ORCID | date=2025-12-18 | url=https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3536-554X | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite web | title=Arthur Ragauskas wants to make green energy the new norm | website=American Association for the Advancement of Science (AAAS) | date=2014-05-06 | url=https://www.aaas.org/taxonomy/term/4/arthur-ragauskas-wants-make-green-energy-new-norm | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref>

At the [[Georgia Institute of Technology]], he has worked on research programs integrating chemistry, [[materials science]], and biotechnology. He also serves as a senior researcher associated with the BioEnergy Science Center and related U.S. Department of Energy initiatives at [[Oak Ridge National Laboratory]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Ragauskas Named Fourteenth UT-ORNL Governor's Chair | website=Naylor Association Solutions | url=https://www.naylornetwork.com/ppi-otw/articles/index-v2.asp?aid=255590&issueID=32342 | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |title=Arthur J. Ragauskas |website=Oak Ridge National Laboratory |date=28 August 2018 |url=https://www.ornl.gov/staff-profile/arthur-j-ragauskas |access-date=2025-06-15}}</ref>

Ragauskas has served on the editorial boards of journals, [[Biofuels, Bioproducts and Biorefining]],<ref>{{cite web | title=Biofuels, Bioproducts and Biorefining |url=https://scijournals.onlinelibrary.wiley.com/journal/19321031| publisher=Wiley | issn=1932-104X | doi=10.1002/(issn)1932-1031 | page=}}</ref> [[Holzforschung]],<ref>{{cite web | last=Manuscript | first=Submit | title=Holzforschung | website=De Gruyter Brill | date=1947-01-01 | url=https://www.degruyterbrill.com/journal/key/hfsg/html#editorial | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref> [[Frontiers in Energy Research]] -section Bioenergy and Biofuels,<ref>{{cite web | title=Frontiers editor Arthur Ragauskas awarded two prestigious prizes | website=Frontiers editor Arthur Ragauskas awarded two prestigious prizes | date=2014-04-08 | url=https://www.frontiersin.org/news/2014/04/08/frontiers-editor-arthur-ragauskas-awarded-two-prestigious-prizes | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref> and Fuel Processing Technology.<ref>{{cite web | title=Fuel Processing Technology | website=ScienceDirect.com by Elsevier | date=2025-12-19 | url=https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/fuel-processing-technology/about/editorial-board | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref>

== Recognition ==
Ragauskas has been elected a fellow of the [[American Association for the Advancement of Science]]<ref>{{cite web | title=Arthur Ragauskas | website=AIChE | date=2020-03-19 | url=https://www.aiche.org/community/bio/arthur-ragauskas-0 | access-date=2025-12-28}}</ref> and also, a fellow of the [[International Academy of Wood Science]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Fellows | website=The International Academy of Wood Science| url=https://www.iaws-web.org/fellows--dues/overview-of-fellows/ | ref={{sfnref|The International Academy of Wood Science}} | access-date=2025-12-28}} (R)- Arthur Jonas RAGAUSKAS (USA)</ref>

Until January 2026, the research work of Ragauskas has received more than 84,000 citations at [[Google Scholar]].<ref>{{cite web | title=Art Ragauskas; A.J. Ragauskas; Arthur Ragauskas; Arthur J. Ragauskas | website=Google Scholar | url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=FFZAU_kAAAAJ&hl=en | access-date=2026-01-13}}</ref>
